Guarantee that every finished action leaves a terminal record on disk. This is the directly reported symptom of [B\_235](B_235_end_of_action_not_logged.md).

## Current state

Three paths end an action without writing its end.

`persistRootActivity` (`desktop/src/actions/action/action_run.js:479`) returns `false` without writing any record when the root action is an agent and `rootConversationId` is not a string. That happens when the agent phase threw before a conversation id existed. The action ends silently: no activity record, no error surfaced.

In `AgentRunnerService.handleClose` (`agent_runner_service.js:731-752`), `continuedTurnFailedBeforeStart` — a continued turn that failed before the turn started — skips `persistConversation` entirely. The in-memory conversation has already been transitioned to its terminal status, and the `closed` event carries that corrected conversation to the renderer, but the file on disk keeps the previous checkpoint, which says `running`.

When `persistConversation` does run and throws, the error is routed to `onCompletionError` and the `closed` event is still emitted. Again the renderer looks right for the rest of the session while the file says `running`. This is why the wrong state survives a restart.

## implementation details

* `persistRootActivity` always writes a record. With no conversation id, write a failure record carrying the cause of the agent-phase failure instead of returning early. The early return is removed, not widened.
* `handleClose` persists the terminal conversation for `continuedTurnFailedBeforeStart` as well. The turn never starting is a reason for a `failed` record, not a reason to skip writing.
* A failing terminal persist is retried a bounded number of times; a still-failing write is surfaced to the user and logged with the run id and conversation id. The run never completes silently with `running` on disk.
* Emit the `closed` event only after the terminal state is durable, or mark the event as unpersisted so consumers know the file disagrees. Renderer and file must not diverge without anyone knowing.
* Log the terminal write alongside the existing `[agent:complete]` entry so a missing record is traceable after the fact.
* Tests: agent phase throwing before a conversation exists writes a failure record; continued turn failing before start writes a terminal record; persist failure retries and then reports; no path reaches process exit with an in-memory terminal status and `running` on disk.

## acceptance criteria

* Every action run leaves an activity record with a terminal status, including runs that fail before an agent conversation exists.
* A continued turn that fails before starting is persisted as failed.
* A terminal write that cannot succeed is reported to the user and logged; it is never swallowed.
* After any run ends, restarting the app never shows that run as still running.

entries.content:
Read spec + code. Plan below. No edits yet.

## Findings

**1. `action_run.js:487-489`** — `persistRootActivity` early-returns `false` when root is agent and `this.rootConversationId` is not a string. Happens when agent phase throws before conversation id assigned (`executeAction` sets it only on success). Result: zero activity records on disk.

**2. `agent_runner_service.js:753-765`** — `handleClose` skips `persistConversation` when `continuedTurnFailedBeforeStart`. In-memory conversation already transitioned to `failed`; disk keeps `running` checkpoint.

**3. same block** — persist throw routes to `onCompletionError`, no retry, no log; `closed` event emitted regardless, so renderer shows terminal while file says `running`.

Note: `closed` event *is* already emitted after the persist attempt (line 768), so ordering is fine; only the "unpersisted" marker is missing.

Note on record shape: agent history entries in `app/src/data/electron_action_bridge.ts:88` require `rootConversationId: string`. A run that died before a conversation existed has none, so the failure record must use the existing command-shaped `details` fallback (`type: 'command'`, `output` = failure message) rather than agent details. No renderer type change needed.

## Change Plan

**Block 1 — action_run.js: always write root activity**
- Remove early return in `persistRootActivity`. Agent root without conversation id falls through to existing `details` fallback, carrying `errorMessage(failure)` as output.
- Tests in `action_run.test.mjs`: agent root action throwing before conversation exists → one `appendAndCommitActionActivity` call, record `status: 'failed'`, details output contains cause.

**Block 2 — agent_runner_service.js: terminal persist always, bounded retry, logged**
- Persist terminal conversation for `continuedTurnFailedBeforeStart` too (drop the condition).
- New `persistTerminalConversation(run)` helper: up to 3 attempts; each failure logged via `logAgentEvent('[agent:terminalPersist]', { attempt, conversationId, error, runId })`; success logged once alongside `[agent:complete]`.
- On final failure: `closed` event carries `persisted: false`; error still goes to `onCompletionError` (which rejects the run completion → action publishes `failed` → user sees it).
- Tests in `agent_runner_state.test.mjs`: continued turn failing before start calls `persistConversation`; persist failing twice then succeeding emits `closed` with `persisted: true` and no completion error; persist failing all attempts calls `onCompletionError` and emits `closed` with `persisted: false`.

**Block 3 — event flag through to renderer types**
- Add optional `persisted?: boolean` to the `closed` run event in `app/src/data/data_types.ts:433`. Consumers (`agent_conversation_service.ts:58`, `remote_control_storage_service.ts:1183`) unchanged — flag is informational.
- `npm run typecheck` + affected vitest/node test files.

**Block 4 — spec status** → set `status: ready` in `B_239_always_write_terminal_activity_record.md`.

Approve? Say go and I implement blocks 1-4.

Done. All 4 blocks implemented.

**Block 1 — `desktop/src/actions/action/action_run.js`**
Removed the early return in `persistRootActivity`. An agent root run whose agent phase threw before a conversation id existed now falls through to the command-shaped `details` fallback, so the failure cause lands in `output` and a `failed` record reaches disk.

**Block 2 — `desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_runner_service.js`**
- `handleClose` no longer skips the terminal write for a continued turn that failed before starting; the write is unconditional.
- New method `persistTerminalConversation(run)` retries up to `TERMINAL_PERSIST_ATTEMPTS` (3) and logs every attempt via `logAgentEvent('[agent:terminalPersist]', …)` with run id, conversation id, status, attempt, and outcome — traceable next to the existing `[agent:complete]` entry. A final failure is returned, then handed to `onCompletionError`, which rejects the run completion so the action publishes `failed`.
- The `closed` event now carries `persisted`, so renderer consumers can tell that the file disagrees.

**Block 3 — `app/src/data/data_types.ts`**
Added optional `persisted?: boolean` to the `closed` run event. `npm run typecheck` in `app` clean.

**Block 4** — spec `status` set to `ready`.

**Tests**
- `action_run.test.mjs`: new case — agent fails before a conversation exists, one activity append, `status: 'failed'`, cause in `details.output`, no `rootConversationId`.
- `agent_runner_state.test.mjs`: rewrote `leaves persisted continuation unchanged when provider turn never starts` (it encoded the bug) into `persists the failed continuation when the provider turn never starts`; extended the persist-failure case to assert 3 attempts plus `persisted: false`; added a retry-then-success case asserting 2 attempts, `persisted: true`, and normal completion.
- Suites: `action_run` 54 passed, `agent_runner_state` 58 passed, app `services/agents` + `services/actions` 341 passed. ESLint clean on changed files.

Pre-existing, unrelated failures in the worktree (untouched by this change): `agent_profiles_parity`, `action_agent_executor`, `action_scheduler_service`, `schedule_store` — model-name and schedule expectations.
